data.name: Estefania
data.gender_notes: Estefania is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Crowned with a garland of stars
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word stella (star), Estefania means 'crowned with a garland of stars'. This beautiful name has a rich history in Christianity, being the name of several saints and revered biblical figures. The name Estefania carries the meaning “Crowned with a garland of stars” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Estefania usually hope their child will grow to embody crowned with a garland of stars and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine favor and celestial grace
data.etymology: Estefania belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Crowned with a garland of stars.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Estefania total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: סטפניה
in_hebrew.meaning: עטרת או כתר של אלוהים משמעות השם סטפניה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם סטפניה מקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו עטרת או כתר של אלוהים. השם נגזר מהמילה היוונית סטפאנוס שפירושה כתר. בספר מעשי השליחים, סטפנוס היה אחד משבעה דיאקונים הראשונים של הכנסייה הנוצרית. השם סטפניה הוא נשי של השם סטפנוס ומשמעותו היא אותה עטרת אלוהים.

in_greek.name: Στεφανία
in_greek.meaning: Στεφανία σημαίνει το στεφάνι του Θεού
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Στεφανία προέρχεται από το ελληνικό όνομα Στεφανός, που σημαίνει στεφάνι. Ο Στεφανός ήταν ένας από τους πρώτους επτά διακόνους της Χριστιανικής Εκκλησίας, όπως αναφέρεται στις Πράξεις των Αποστόλων. Το όνομα Στεφανία είναι το θηλυκό ισοδύναμο του Στεφανός και συμβολίζει το στεφάνι του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Stephania
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Stephania originates from the Greek name Stephanos, meaning crown or wreath. In Christian tradition, Stephen was one of the first deacons of the Church, mentioned in the Acts of the Apostles. The name Stephania represents the crown or wreath of God, symbolizing spiritual achievement and divine favor.

in_english.name: Estefania
in_english.meaning: Crown or wreath of God, divine crown
in_english.long_meaning: The name Estefania is derived from the Greek name Stephanos, meaning crown or wreath. This name has been adopted into various cultures and is used in Christian traditions to signify a crown or wreath of God. Historically, the name is associated with Saint Stephen, one of the first deacons of the Christian Church, mentioned in the New Testament. The name Estefania symbolizes spiritual victory, divine favor, and is often associated with qualities such as leadership, faith, and devotion.

Naming a child Estefania pays homage to this heritage and highlights the family's commitment to their faith.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, the name Estefania carries a powerful spiritual meaning. The name Estefania inspires a sense of wonder and awe, encouraging its bearer to strive for spiritual heights, just as a star does in the vast cosmos.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Estefania is derived from the Greek name "Aphrodisia," which honors Aphrodite, the goddess of love, beauty, and fertility. In Christian tradition, Estefania represents the embodiment of divine love and grace, inspiring passion, creativity, and nurturing abilities.
